name: kb_422_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: HTTPHeader describes a custom header to be used in HTTP probes

schema.description: HTTPGetAction describes an action based on HTTP Get requests.

host.description: Host name to connect to, defaults to the pod IP. You probably want to set "Host" in httpHeaders instead.

httpHeaders.description: Custom headers to set in the request. HTTP allows repeated headers.

path.description: Path to access on the HTTP server.

port.description: Name or number of the port to access on the container. Number must be in the range 1 to 65535. Name must be an IANA_SVC_NAME.

scheme.description: Scheme to use for connecting to the host. Defaults to HTTP.

description: The HTTP GET probe is configured to contact the service `example-service.default.svc` over **HTTPS** on port **8080**, targeting the **`/healthz`** endpoint. The request includes two custom headers: **`User-Agent`** set to **`MyProbe/1.0`** and **`X-Custom-Header`** set to **`custom-value`**.
